thread:
jess_success: FYI Vertiq (healthcare analytics) opened a model onboarding request — they need a fine-tuned clinical summarization model that handles PHI. Asking for private deployment + HIPAA controls. Can eng/legal weigh in?

sam_ml: Thanks Jess. Key questions: will they bring PHI in training or only inference? Also need eval sets for safety/regression. Recommend sandbox evals first.

jess_success: They said inference only, but examples include full discharge summaries. They want redaction + hallucination guardrails. Renewal at risk if we don't demo by end of month.

mia_legal: If PHI will be processed we need a signed BAA and details on the data flows. We'll need to confirm KMS, audit logs, and retention policy. No data exfil allowed. pinging @ryan_platform for VPC/onprem options.

ryan_platform: We can offer Redwood Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS. Need network specs and peering window. For on-prem, we'll need a 2-week lead for infra + security review. Also, model variants: recommend Llama2-70B-8bit q4 or a condensed variant — depends on latency.

sam_ml: For evals, I'll spin up an eval harness. Ask them for 200 labeled examples across 4 prompt slices (med hx, meds, labs, discharge). We'll run hallucination tests + a toxicity/profile leakage check. Example command:
```
./eval/run.py --model=vertiq-ft-2025 --slices=medhx,meds,labs,discharge --metrics=hallucination,pii-leak
```

marco_ops: ETA for canary infra? If we get specs today we can schedule a dedicated pool in ~10 business days. Need cost approval for reserved capacity.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RW-4382: 'Vertiq healthcare model onboarding' assigned to sam_ml,ryan_platform,marco_ops. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-4382 :white_check_mark:

jess_success: I'll request the 200 examples and BAA from Vertiq. I'll set up an enablement call for Wed 10am PT. Please add agenda items (security review, eval plan, canary window).

mia_legal: Add: data retention window (90 days?), eradication procedure, and contact for breach notices.

sam_ml: Noted. I'll prepare a short eval rubric and a lightweight redaction layer prototype to demo.

jess_success: thanks all — renewal flagged as 'at risk' in CS dashboard; aim to have a demo + security signoff before EOM. Updates in thread only. :rocket:
